research_principles.confidence: confidence describes evidence quality, not popularity
research_principles.freshness: freshness is tracked separately from confidence
research_principles.provenance: every publishable claim must point to one or more source ids
research_principles.sentiment: community sentiment must not be promoted to objective fact without corroboration
research_principles.entity_status: unknown or weakly sourced entities stay in research state until independently corroborated
research_principles.geography: pincode, locality and food-corridor relationships require explicit evidence; do not infer a corridor from one business
research_principles.contradictions: conflicting claims are preserved as unresolved evidence rather than silently collapsed
research_principles.pincodes: a locality may map to multiple pincodes; retain sub-area postal evidence instead of forcing one canonical pincode
research_principles.taxonomy: canonical dishes and culinary identities are separate from current venue availability
